description: Describe the applicability vocabulary of a data module so a product can be chosen: the ACT product attributes (ids, names, enumerations/patterns, which one identifies the product), the CCT condition types and conditions, the PCT products (ready-made product values), the applic statements in the data module (ids and display texts), and which attributes used by the statements have no value in the PCT. Nothing is evaluated here; pass the chosen values as "product" to read_data_module.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

dmc.description: DMC of the data module to read from the CSDB (e.g. "S1000DBIKE-AAA-D00-00-00-00AA-041A-A"; "DMC-" prefix optional). Alternative to path/xml.

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: describe_applicability
